body:
HOLD — exact aa2b04c32f348e2e5bb80b49ee5dad642b64d292 has one runnable public-codec fixed-point falsifier. The three assigned attacks themselves PASS; the hold is priced by the tested two-file patch below.

Exact replay:
- immutable archive tree b812442641c531e90b45e291145ae31f49b19a4f; 9,176 Git/archive/extracted entries; archive SHA-256 96dca063ec789e7de490a19fd93dc43a6ed928e1fa2b131785ac85a27298f086;
- focused exact-export suites: acquire OutputSuite 17/17, external consumerattack OutputConstructionProbeSuite 16/16, codec OutputCodecSuite 10/10, view OutputSuite plus external view probe 30/30; all zero failures, terminal exits 0. Logs SHA-256 3630aa91571caa57f5c87142c17522df6490043782483fcbae9ca81a16941009 and ca9e30f0353461d4fb0aba33bcc32efe56c8144f21f29dcfa85581a8e0d33b89.
- required authority attack PASS: public BuildReceipt/checked ExtendedBuildReceipt may match identity but cannot issue AcquisitionViewAuthority, ViewBasis.ValidatedBuild, or AdmittedViewBasis; external apply/copy/fromProduct/Mirror/validatedBuild doors refuse.
- required BeforeIntake attack PASS: lawful SourceOutcome.beforeIntake round-trips through bare and byte-context StoryOutputResultCodec.decode.
- required bytes attack PASS: full public result-codec probe shows constructed, admitted-refusal, and decoded-refusal all refuse bare decode and pass only with exact bytes; BeforeIntake passes both routes. Probe source SHA-256 72747a45f7daafcc025ab6ed8543a310c5335b78c3e2c5bc28b9694e6a409b26; log SHA-256 07514111a3c1f495b856fb88ab2c60580f702d477c1c8a3510b603270b8bbf8d; GATE_EXIT=0.

Falsifier:

The public validators accept a result whose source is Refused(Admitted(original), strictDecodeFailure) and whose SemanticOutcome.Refused repeats that same already-checked OutputFailure. StoryOutputResultCodec.encode succeeds. StoryOutputResultCodec.decode(encoded, exactOriginalBytes) fails at .acquisition.semantic.errors[0] with "decode failure detail requires contextual decoding with original bytes" because contextual source reconstruction is followed by the non-contextual semantic-failure decoder. Both AcquisitionAccount.of and StoryOutputResult.of returned valid first. Failing external probe source SHA-256 17d7b1d1d6f1a29d4a24171f7321d6f556198fed4741b03b152a6dd4ad09a5d7; log SHA-256 72b801c9bf7d4be50edcee2cf8315c11092840ec3865ce731a29b9c63b5b9c19; GATE_EXIT=1 at the named assertion.

Chain: permits=yes; occurs=no production caller established at this SHA (SemanticOutcome.Refused appears only in the type, codecs, and view matching); produces=exact contextual decode refusal measured; consumes=the public canonical StoryOutputResult codec fixed-point. This is not reported as an observed pipeline failure.

Tested patch, exact two source files:

```diff
--- codec/output_acquire.scala
+++ codec/output_acquire.scala
@@
+  /** Reuse a source failure already checked against exact bytes when semantic refusal cites it. */
+  private[codec] def admitSemanticOutcome(c: HCursor, source: SourceOutcome) =
+    field[String](c, "status").flatMap {
+      case "refused" =>
+        field[Vector[Json]](c, "errors")
+          .flatMap(nonEmpty(c, "errors", _))
+          .flatMap(_.traverse { encoded =>
+            source match
+              case SourceOutcome.Refused(_, failure) if encoded == failure.asJson => Right(failure)
+              case _ => encoded.as[OutputFailure]
+          })
+          .map(SemanticOutcome.Refused.apply)
+      case _ => summon[Decoder[SemanticOutcome]].apply(c)
+    }
--- codec/output.scala
+++ codec/output.scala
@@
-          semantic <- field[SemanticOutcome](ac, "semantic")
+          semanticCursor <- ac.downField("semantic").success.toRight(
+            io.circe.DecodingFailure("missing semantic outcome", ac.history)
+          )
+          semantic <- OutputAcquireCodecs.admitSemanticOutcome(semanticCursor, source)
```

The disposable patch kills the exact falsifier: constructed/admitted/decoded/BeforeIntake probe all PASS, GATE_EXIT=0, log SHA-256 b23986b2c5b70e272140df2186233abfa137c8fcefd75e561ecfb1b3eef110c4. Existing codec OutputCodecSuite remains 10/10 and scalafmtCheckAll passes, GATE_EXIT=0, log SHA-256 6410e1b4b0b32db9eb84244c2adc392f0b0316bcd0d7ff43463c77c7d615f74d.

Please fold this patch plus a permanent regression assertion into the pre-proposal successor, then request only a focused exact-SHA replay of this falsifier. No shared-tree source was changed.
